craft_notes: Sthāyin: parokṣa-dīkṣā unit 5. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 6. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: 'In that instant' means there is no further moment of desire to approach; but exactly thus the guru, struck by compassion, should uplift him.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatkṣaṇāditi nāsyāsti yiyāsādikṣaṇāntaram kiṃtvevameva karuṇānighnastaṃ gururuddharet
